run_train_eval_loop: run the train and eval loop for a PHYRE agent on a specified fold and output directory
run_multi_fold_training: run training across multiple fold IDs by passing a comma-separated fold ID list
get_train_test_split: get the train and test task ID tuples for a given eval setup name and fold
find_all_agents: find and return all concrete subclasses of offline_agents.Agent as a name-to-class dictionary
parse_and_log_args: parse command-line arguments for agent type, fold ID, output dir, and agent-specific options
